population: all original512 development UIDs retained in every window, including no-feedback users; no outcome-based selection

confidence.method: same paired UID multiplicities for all methods and windows

scope: Quality-only exploratory prefix analysis of previously generated causal E14 trajectories. Not final costs, independent confirmation or three-seed evidence. All four windows retained; any adopted protocol must be frozen before independent population verification.
motivation: Publishing-time calibration is compared to E14 average; test whether intervention benefit is concentrated near handover rather than assuming the full window is representative.
